title: Fusion history: an interactive timeline
description: Explore about a hundred events of fusion history from 1895 to ITER by era, theme and search, follow machines to the world map, and find the patterns: secrecy and openness, claims and checks, a wider world and slow steps.

sources.title: Timeline of nuclear fusion (Wikipedia): an overview used to cross-check the order of the events
Joint European Torus (Wikipedia): 16 MW of fusion power from 24 MW of heating in 1997
Tokamak (Wikipedia): T-1 at the end of 1958
ITER (Wikipedia): the 2024 baseline (start of research operation 2034, deuterium–deuterium 2035, deuterium–tritium 2039)
sources.note: Institutional plans as of November 2026, not results.
